title: Candidate profile contract
description: The candidate profile: the only source of facts about the candidate for the CV writer and the validator. Blocks follow tailor-cv/profile-data.md (P-01 to P-11). Every key of the version is present; null means no value, never an empty list or string. Links between objects are ids: the schema checks their shape, code checks that they are unique and that every reference exists.

schema_version.description: Contract version, "<major>.<minor>". A consumer checks the major version only.

meta.description: Where the facts come from and when the profile last changed.

person.description: P-01: the name and the current or last job title with its level.

search.description: P-02: the roles the candidate looks for, where and how they want to work, and where they are now.

contacts.description: P-03: the contacts printed in the CV header.

skills.description: P-04: skills, each with the jobs and projects that back it; null when none is known yet.

achievements.description: P-05: achievements, each linked to exactly one project inside a job or outside jobs; null when none is known yet.

jobs.description: P-06: jobs, each with its roles and the projects inside it; null when none is known yet.

projects.description: P-07: projects outside jobs (own, open source, study, made for a vacancy); null when there are none.

period_notes.description: P-07: context notes for periods between jobs that the candidate chose to give (for example parental leave); null when there are none. Never asked, never a reason invented by the agent.

languages.description: P-08: languages with the candidate's level; null when none is known yet.

hobbies.description: P-10: hobbies and outside activities; null when there are none. Not asked.

decisions.description: P-11: records of the candidate's confirmations and overrides of rules; null when there are none. Not printed.

nullable_text.description: Plain text, not empty; null when there is no value.

text_list.description: A list of plain text items; null when there are none, never an empty list.

month.description: A date as precise as the candidate knows it: "YYYY" or "YYYY-MM".

month_or_present.description: An end date, "YYYY" or "YYYY-MM", or "present" for something still going on.

year.description: A year, "YYYY"; null when not known.

period.description: A period of time. The agent never estimates dates: a period it does not know is asked.

start.description: First month or year of the period.

end.description: Last month or year of the period, or "present".

nullable_period.description: A period, or null when the dates are not known.

source_id.description: Id of a source in meta.sources, prefix "src-".

project_id.description: Id of a project inside a job or outside jobs, prefix "prj-".

note_id.description: Id of a period note, prefix "note-".

decision_id.description: Id of a decision record, prefix "dec-".

unit_id.description: Id of a job, project, achievement, skill or period note.

origin.description: Where a unit's facts come from. A fact without an origin is not used. source_cv: quoted from a source, with source and quote, date null. candidate: an answer of the candidate in the chat, with the date, source and quote null. agent_confirmed: a proposal of the agent that the candidate confirmed or corrected, with the date, source and quote null.

source.description: For source_cv: the id of the source in meta.sources; otherwise null.

quote.description: For source_cv: the quote of the place in the source the facts come from; otherwise null.

date.description: For candidate and agent_confirmed: the day of the answer or confirmation, "YYYY-MM-DD"; otherwise null.

nullable_origin.description: The origin of a single block, or null when every field of the block is null.

source.description: A document or conversation the profile was read from.

id.description: Id the origins refer to, prefix "src-".

kind.description: index_cv: a source CV read by the CV reader; file: another document of the candidate; chat: a conversation with the candidate.

location.description: URL or file path of the source; null for a chat or when unknown.

read_at.description: When the source was read, ISO 8601 date-time.

sources.description: The sources the source_cv origins refer to; null when nothing was read from a document.

updated_at.description: When the profile was last changed, ISO 8601 date-time.

person.description: P-01: who the candidate is (GEN-05, HEADER-03, SUM-01).

name.description: The name the candidate uses on a CV.

title.description: The current or last job title, without the level.

level.description: The level of the title, for example "Senior" or "Lead"; never one the jobs do not support.

origin.description: Where the name, title and level come from.

search.description: P-02: the candidate's search goals and location. These are the candidate's plans, never guessed from a vacancy.

target_roles.description: The roles the candidate looks for.

apply_locations.description: Countries and cities where the candidate applies.

relocation.description: The candidate's relocation plans, plain text.

region.description: The region of the search for GEN-09, for example "EU".

work_formats.description: The work formats the candidate accepts.

current_city.description: The city the candidate lives in now, with the country when useful.

time_zone.description: The candidate's time zone, IANA name (for example "Europe/Berlin") or a UTC offset.

origin.description: Where the search goals and location come from.

contacts.description: P-03: contacts for the CV header (HEADER-02); each only when the candidate has it.

phone.description: Phone number as the candidate writes it, with the country code.

skill.description: P-04: a skill (GEN-12, SKILL-01). Its evidence ids back it for the validator and are not printed.

name.description: The skill as the CV writes it, for example "TypeScript".

kind.description: What the skill is; null when not stated.

evidence.description: Ids of the jobs and projects where the skill was used; null when there is none, then the skill needs a recorded confirmation (P-11).

achievement.description: P-05: one achievement (EXP-02, EXP-04, EXP-05, GEN-13), linked to exactly one project.

project.description: Id of the project the achievement belongs to, inside a job or outside jobs.

number.description: The number of the result as the candidate gives it, for example "35%" or "2x"; null when there is none. The agent never makes one up.

number_context.description: The context of the number: baseline or period, scale such as team, budget or users (EXP-04).

measure.description: What the result is measured by, for example "page load time".

contribution.description: own: the candidate's own result; team: a team result the candidate took part in; null when not known yet.

own_part.description: What the candidate did in a team result.

ai_involved.description: Whether the work involved AI (EXP-05); null when not stated, then it is read from the achievement or asked.

role.description: P-06: a title the candidate held at a job for a period. A job with a promotion has one role per title.

title.description: The job title of the role, with its level as the employer wrote it.

period.description: When the candidate held the role.

description.description: A short description of the role, Markdown; null until proposed from the duties and confirmed.

job_project.description: P-06: a project inside a job. A job with no named projects has one implicit project, so its achievements still have a link.

name.description: Name of the project or product.

context.description: The context of the project, Markdown: the product, the team, what it was for.

role.description: The candidate's role in the project.

period.description: When the candidate worked on the project; null when it is the whole job or not known.

job.description: P-06: a job at one employer (EXP-01, EXP-03, SUM-01, SUM-02, GAP-01).

industry.description: The industry of the employer; proposed by the agent and confirmed when the source does not say.

market_types.description: The market types of the employer.

roles.description: The roles the candidate held at the job, most recent first. Their periods give the dates of the job.

projects.description: The projects inside the job; at least one, implicit when the job names none.

side_project.description: P-07: a project outside jobs (PROJ-01). Projects with dates fill the periods between jobs. Only a project the candidate has done.

kind.description: own: the candidate's own project; open_source: a contribution to open source; study: made while studying; vacancy_task: made for a vacancy.

context.description: What the project is and the candidate's part in it, Markdown.

period.description: When the project was done; null when the candidate gives no dates.

result.description: The outcome of the project, plain text; measured results are achievements (P-05).

link.description: URL of the project; null when there is none.

period_note.description: P-07: a context note for a period between jobs, only when the candidate gives it (GEN-10).

note.description: The note in the candidate's words, for example "Parental leave".

language.description: P-08: a language the candidate speaks (SKILL-03). A level is never raised.

name.description: The language, in English, for example "German".

origin.description: Where the language and level come from.

qualification.description: P-09: a degree or an equivalent qualification (EDU-01).

title.description: The qualification, for example "MSc in Computer Science".

qualifications.description: Degrees and equivalent qualifications, highest first; null when there are none.

certifications.description: Professional certifications; null when there are none.

hobby.description: P-10: a hobby or an outside activity (GEN-07).

relevance.description: What makes it relevant or impressive, when the candidate states it.

decision.description: P-11: a record of the candidate's decision (GEN-10, GEN-11, GEN-12). The validator treats an override or an unbacked term with no record as a failure of the rule.

kind.description: confirmation: a confirmation a rule asks to record (GEN-11, GEN-12); override: the candidate kept something against a rule's advice (GEN-10).

rule.description: The id of the rule the decision is about, for example "GEN-12".

subject.description: What the decision covers, plain text.

warning.description: For an override: the warning the agent gave; otherwise null.

refs.description: Ids of the units the decision covers; null when it covers none.
